title: Deceit in the Guildhall of Virtue
author: Doug Egan
description:
Captain Prodigious lies in a heap on the marble floor, his cape twisted around his legs. Who among this team of superheroes imagined their leader could be defeated? Already you suspect foul play — an assassin within your own guildhall — but by what means and for what motive? It will be up to you to solve this mystery. That has always been your role. You are Brainioid, the brainiest of all superheroes.

Content warning: Mild profanity. See in-game notes for content details.
